name: Uncommon  Assistive Technology Applications Execution Via AtBroker.EXE
description: Detects the start of a non built-in assistive technology applications via "Atbroker.EXE".
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate, non-default assistive technology applications execution
query: ((process.executable:*\\AtBroker.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:AtBroker.exe) AND process.command_line:*start*) AND (NOT (process.command_line:(*animations* OR *audiodescription* OR *caretbrowsing* OR *caretwidth* OR *colorfiltering* OR *cursorindicator* OR *cursorscheme* OR *filterkeys* OR *focusborderheight* OR *focusborderwidth* OR *highcontrast* OR *keyboardcues* OR *keyboardpref* OR *livecaptions* OR *magnifierpane* OR *messageduration* OR *minimumhitradius* OR *mousekeys* OR *Narrator* OR *osk* OR *overlappedcontent* OR *showsounds* OR *soundsentry* OR *speechreco* OR *stickykeys* OR *togglekeys* OR *voiceaccess* OR *windowarranging* OR *windowtracking* OR *windowtrackingtimeout* OR *windowtrackingzorder*))) AND (NOT process.command_line:*Oracle_JavaAccessBridge*)
